surfaces.name: Fill free space?
surfaces.reason: A confirmation whose text is the whole explanation: how much is written, where, and how much stays free (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4); the screen's help explains it under Confirmation.

surfaces.name: Color theme
surfaces.reason: A single-choice list of colour themes whose items are the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4); the screen's help explains it under Color theme.

surfaces.name: About Filler
surfaces.reason: A window whose content is the whole explanation: what the app does, the running version and the author with the site address (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4); its Help button opens the screen's help, which explains it under About Filler.

surfaces.name: Choose folder
surfaces.reason: The operating system's folder picker, a common dialog the app does not draw (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Schedule filling?
surfaces.reason: A confirmation whose text is the whole explanation: the folder, the storage, the space kept free and the daily limit (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4); the screen's help explains it under Editor.

surfaces.name: Delete this schedule?
surfaces.reason: A confirmation whose text is the whole explanation: which schedule stops and that its history stays (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Clear run history?
surfaces.reason: A confirmation whose text is the whole explanation: all recorded run history is removed while saved schedules stay (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Repeat
surfaces.reason: A single-choice list of intervals whose items are the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4); the screen's help explains it under Editor.

surfaces.name: Time
surfaces.reason: The operating system's time picker, a common dialog the app does not draw (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Allow notifications
surfaces.reason: The operating system's permission prompt for the notification of a running fill, a common dialog the app does not draw; the phone asks when a schedule is saved and the watch at the first Fill (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Filler (watch)
surfaces.reason: The watch screen has no top-right corner and no keyboard, so it carries no help button; the phone and the watch share one application id and its help is the Filler screen's, whose entry 'watch' names the watch screen (CONTEXT-HELP item L).
